description: Ministry of Labour - Appointed P. Nawaratne as the Arbitrator to the Industrial Disputes between Mr. H. S. L. Perera No. 219 D, Molligoda Wadduwa and Bata Shoe Company  of Ceylon Ltd. Ratmalana
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns legal/regulatory matters under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains orders made by the Minister under statutory powers to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes, which represents the exercise of regulatory authority and legal procedures for dispute resolution. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function being performed rather than constituting a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses on legal procedures for industrial dispute resolution rather than government structure or personnel changes.
